info.title: Relations API
info.description:
The Relations API manages relationships between entities in Reltio MDM. Relations are typed, directed connections between exactly two entities — for example, EmployedBy (Person → Organization), HasAddress (Person → Location), or AffiliatedWith (Organization → Organization).

Each relation has a type (defined in the tenant configuration), a start entity and an end entity, optional attributes (e.g., start date, role), and its own crosswalks and survivorship rules. Relations can be directed (A→B), undirected (A↔B), or bidirectional.

This API covers searching, reading, and deleting relations, as well as graph traversal operations — one-hop connections and N-hop traversal — for navigating entity networks.

environment.description: Reltio environment name (e.g. dev, qa, prod)

get.description:
Searches and retrieves relationships, optionally filtered by query parameters. Common filters include relation type, start/end entity URIs, and attribute values.

Supports the same `filter` (RQL), `select`, pagination (`offset`, `max`), sorting (`sort`, `order`), and `options` parameters as the entity search.

200.description: An array of relation objects matching the query.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller does not have permission to read relations.

get.description: Retrieves a single relationship by its URI. The response includes the relation type, start and end entity references, relation-level attributes, crosswalks, and operational metadata.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

404.description: Not Found — no relation exists with the specified URI.

delete.description:
Deletes a single relationship by its URI. This permanently removes the relation and all its crosswalks and attributes.

**Warning:** Deletion is irreversible. In production, consider end-dating the relation's crosswalks instead.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

404.description: Not Found — no relation exists with the specified URI.

post.description:
Retrieves entities connected to the specified entity via relationships (one-hop traversal). The request body defines which relation types and entity types to include in the results.

For each connection direction, specify:
- `inRelations` — relation types where the target entity is the start object
- `outRelations` — relation types where the target entity is the end object
- `entityTypes` — which entity types to return from the connected end

This is the primary endpoint for building entity detail pages that show related records (e.g., all Organizations a Person is employed by).

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: The entity URI to find connections for.

200.description: Connected entities grouped by relation type and direction.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

404.description: Not Found — no entity exists with the specified URI.

get.description:
Traverses the entity graph N hops from the starting entity. Returns all entities and relations reachable within the specified depth.

Use `deep` to control traversal depth (default 1), `graphTypeURIs` or `relationTypeURIs` to limit which relation types are traversed, and `max` to cap the result size.

The response includes a `dataComplete` flag — when `false`, the traversal hit limits and the result is partial. Use `limitCreditsConsumption` to get an HTTP 507 instead of partial data.

Ideal for building graph visualizations and network analysis views.

200.description: Graph traversal result with entities and relations.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

404.description: Not Found — no entity exists with the specified URI.

507.description: Insufficient Storage — traversal hit credit limits (when `limitCreditsConsumption=true`).

Relation.title: Relation
Relation.description: A typed relationship connecting two entities. Each relation has a start entity, end entity, direction, optional attributes, and crosswalks from contributing source systems.

type.description: The relation type URI from the tenant configuration.

startObject.description: The start entity reference. Contains at minimum the entity URI and type.

direction.description: The direction of the relationship. `directed`: A→B only. `undirected`: A↔B (no direction). `bidirectional`: both A→B and B→A.

attributes.description: Relation-level attributes (e.g., start date, role, title).

Crosswalk.title: Crosswalk
Crosswalk.description: A source-specific record identifier linking a Reltio object to its originating system.

ConnectionsRequest.title: Connections Request
ConnectionsRequest.description: Defines which connections to retrieve for an entity. Specify relation types by direction and which entity types to return.

entityTypes.description: Entity types to return from connected entities.

inRelations.description: Relation type URIs where the queried entity is the end object (incoming).

outRelations.description: Relation type URIs where the queried entity is the start object (outgoing).

HopResult.title: Hop Result
HopResult.description: Result of an N-hop graph traversal from a starting entity.

dataComplete.description: Whether the traversal completed without hitting limits. When `false`, the result is partial.

HopEntity.title: Hop Entity
HopEntity.description: A lightweight entity representation in a graph traversal result.

traversedRelations.description: Number of relations traversed to reach this entity.

untraversedRelations.description: Number of relations not yet traversed from this entity.

HopRelation.title: Hop Relation
HopRelation.description: A relation edge in a graph traversal result.
